program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.5),        # diff pair L
    "Ltail": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current sinks L (tail, M8, ref)
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.4, 1.2),        # PMOS mirror load / M7 L
    "Itail": (72e-6, 40e-6, 120e-6),
    "I7":    (230e-6, 150e-6, 290e-6),
    "Cc":    (0.9e-12, 0.4e-12, 2e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # Rz scale vs p2-cancelling value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    gmid_s = 11.0   # NMOS sinks
    gmid_p = 10.0   # PMOS load / M7 (same gm/Id & L -> systematic offset ~0)

    # first stage
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.8)
    # second stage
    m7 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # sinks
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_s, p["Ltail"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_s, p["Ltail"], It, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_s, p["Ltail"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # analytic models
    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    Cout = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (Cout * Cc + C1 * (Cout + Cc)) / (2 * PI)
    Rz = p["kz"] * (Cc + Cout) / (gm7 * Cc)
    dz = 1.0 / gm7 - Rz
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * dz) if abs(dz) > 1e-12 else 1e30
    # mirror pole (pole-zero doublet, partially cancels)
    pm3 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm3)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(z))) * (1 if z < 0 else -1)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias diode
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # diff pair: vinn on diode side, vinp on mirror-output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    # compensation
    n.R("RZ", "x", "xc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "xc", "vout", Cc)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS-input pair, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc compensation)
